user.title: IR Remote HVAC – Emitter
user.description: Give the device a name and select the IR emitter entity that will transmit commands to the AC unit.

protocol.title: IR Remote HVAC – Protocol
protocol.description: Select the IR protocol for your AC brand. Most users can keep the default settings. Enable advanced settings only if your device requires a specific model variant.

advanced.title: IR Remote HVAC – Advanced
advanced.description: Adjust this only if needed. Keep model at -1 for automatic/default behavior. The carrier frequency is derived from the selected model.

temp_step.title: IR Remote HVAC – Temperature Step
temp_step.description: Choose the temperature step supported by your selected protocol/model.

reconfigure.title: IR Remote HVAC – Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the device name and IR emitter, then select the protocol settings.

abort.no_emitters: No IR emitter entities are available. Please set up an emitter integration (e.g. ESPHome or Broadlink) first.
abort.pyhvac_not_installed: The pyhvac library is not installed. Check your Home Assistant installation.

error.invalid_protocol: The selected protocol is not recognised.
error.protocol_unavailable: The selected protocol constant is not available in the installed version of pyhvac. Try upgrading pyhvac.
error.invalid_temp_step: The selected temperature step is not supported for this protocol/model.

init.title: IR Remote HVAC – Options
init.description: Adjust the temperature range, step size, optional temperature/humidity/power sensors, and send debounce delay.

error.invalid_temp_range: Minimum temperature must be less than maximum temperature.
error.invalid_temp_step: The selected temperature step is not supported for this protocol/model.

external_entity_unavailable.title: Configured external entity unavailable
external_entity_unavailable.description: The configured %(role)s (%(entity_id)s) is unavailable or missing. Check that the source integration/device is online, or update IR Remote HVAC options to select another entity.
